restaurant_name: Dentalme Clinic Chiang Mai Phra-Sing Branch Office
text:
I had a teeth cleaning at that clinic, where the doctor proceeded to tell me I had a small cavity. I was surprised that this was suggested without any X-rays. I was hesitant, but I trusted the clinic’s reviews, so he went ahead and fixed the cavity.

The cavity was supposedly so small that it took him only about seven minutes to fix. Only after that did he decide to take the actual X-rays, which confirmed that I don’t have any additional cavities.

However, it has been two weeks now, and the tooth that supposedly had the cavity — and was fixed — hurts a lot. This tooth didn’t hurt at all before his intervention. I don’t know whether what he did caused enamel damage while drilling or something else, but I can’t even brush that tooth now.

All of this is happening while I’m on a trip. I’m no longer in that location and now need to find another place to fix this issue. On top of that, the cleaning was extremely quick, and the price of the cleaning was higher than what I usually pay in the U.S. without insurance.
